title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Authorizing the Guangdong High People's Court to Approve Death Penalty Sentences in Certain Drug Crimes
keywords_en: smuggling; drugs; approval of death penalty for certain drug crimes
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Authorizing the Guangdong High People's Court to Approve Certain Drug Crime Death Penalty Cases

Fa Fa [1993] No. 17

To the Guangdong High People's Court:

In order to severely punish criminal activities such as smuggling, trafficking, transporting, and manufacturing drugs in a timely manner, to protect citizens' physical and mental health, and to maintain public security and order, in accordance with the provisions of Article 13 of the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China, which stipulates that with respect to the approval authority for death penalty cases involving serious endangerment to public safety and public order, the Supreme People's Court may, when necessary, authorize the high people's courts of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government to exercise such authority, and upon deliberation and decision at the 589th meeting of the Adjudication Committee of this Court on August 17, 1993, it is hereby decided that: effective from the date of issuance of this notice, the approval authority for drug crime death penalty cases in Guangdong Province (excluding those drug crime death penalty cases decided in the first instance by your court and those involving foreign elements) is authorized to be exercised by the Guangdong High People's Court in accordance with the law.

This notice is hereby issued, and it is expected that it will be complied with accordingly.

August 18, 1993
